plugins.description: Autonomous PM→dev→QA engine driven by Claude Code — turns approved PRDs into QA'd, human-reviewable, shipped code through a board (a local git-native board or Linear), with two human gates. Nothing runs until you invoke /autodev:init, /autodev:new, or /autodev:loop.
